answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 28715 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: How we can pray in aeroplane because we dont khow the direction of qaba specialy fazar and isha magrib because it is very less time ang for magrib and fazar at what time according to dubai from where we r going or from india time where we have to reach ex 6.00pm of dubai or 7.30pm of india time explane in detail Question: how we can pray in aeroplane because we dont khow the direction of qaba specialy fazar and isha magrib because it is very less time ang for magrib and fazar at what time according to dubai from where we r going or from india time where we have to reach ex 6.00pm of dubai or 7.30pm of india time explane in detail plzzzzzzzzz Answer ID: 28715 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 138/145/B=1432) You should offer salah by making enquiry if you do not know the qiblah direction, i.e. think in your heart where qiblah might be and offer salah towards the direction to which your heart tends. Your salah would be valid. In the same way, at the time of offering salah assess whether the time of salah remains or not? Offer salah if the time of salah remains otherwise, offer its qaza. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
